case_name: Estate of Andrews, C. Appeal of:Winsor, J.

issues.label: Allocation of burden of proof
issues.why: Whether the executor/counsel bear the initial burden to prove fee reasonableness or objectants must prove the account incorrect.

issues.label: Correct standard for fee reasonableness
issues.why: Whether LaRocca's multi-factor reasonableness analysis governs or local flat-fee guidelines suffice.

issues.label: Weight of Donofrio local guidelines
issues.why: Whether county guidelines create a binding safe harbor or merely a rebuttable prima facie criterion requiring further review.

issues.label: Guidelines applied to large estate
issues.why: Whether percentage guidelines developed for routine/smaller estates properly extend to a $2.28 million estate.

issues.label: Executor commission reasonableness
issues.why: Whether the 5% commission ($114,044) was reasonable given unknown hours and services performed.

issues.label: Attorney fee reasonableness
issues.why: Whether the 6% flat fee ($136,853) was reasonable absent time records or service analysis.

issues.label: Accountant fee to CPA firm
issues.why: Whether the $10,789.94 payment to Deverson, Tanack & Willison was proper and reasonable.

issues.label: Conflict in CPA firm payment
issues.why: Payment to a firm sharing the executor's surname may present a self-dealing concern.

issues.label: Qualifying interested counsel as expert
issues.why: Whether Attorney Vreeland could serve as expert on the reasonableness of his own fees.

issues.label: Weight of self-interested expert testimony
issues.why: Whether the court properly relied on testimony from a witness with direct financial interest.

issues.label: Denial of continuance
issues.why: Whether refusing objectants' continuance to present their own expert was an abuse of discretion.

issues.label: Denial of nonsuit/directed verdict
issues.why: Whether denying nonsuit was proper given the disputed allocation of proof burden.

issues.label: Fiduciary exception to privilege
issues.why: Whether communications between executor and counsel about fees are discoverable by beneficiaries.

issues.label: Availability of surcharge
issues.why: Whether excessive fees/commissions warrant a surcharge against the fiduciaries.

issues.label: Successor executor's duties
issues.why: Whether Ostrowski adequately investigated the prior executor's fees and services before defending the account.

issues.label: Adequacy of account record
issues.why: Whether an account lacking time records supports a reasonableness finding.

issues.label: Reliance on Department of Revenue non-objection
issues.why: Whether the Department's acceptance of fees on tax returns is probative of reasonableness.

issues.label: Standard of review on appeal
issues.why: Whether the Orphans' Court's factual/discretionary rulings survive appellate scrutiny.

issues.label: Preservation of issues under Rule 1925(b)
issues.why: Whether objectants adequately preserved each error in the concise statement.

issues.label: Finality and appealability
issues.why: Whether the July 2025 decree is the appealable final order after the earlier quashed appeal.

issues.label: Complexity of estate assets
issues.why: Whether mineral rights, royalties, and stock holdings justified the fee level.

issues.label: Court's independent duty to scrutinize fees
issues.why: Whether the court must independently review fiduciary compensation regardless of objectants' evidence.
